sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ORDINANCE III OF 2003
ORDINANCE III OF
2003
BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISISON
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINACNE, 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 4th November, 2003]
No. Legis: 1-21/Law/73-II,
dated 4-11-2003.--The following Ordinance made, by the Governor of
Balochistan on 17th October, 2003, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
Commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Public
Service Commission (Amendment) Ordinance, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Public Service Commission Amentment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Act II of 1989

ORDINANCE III OF 2003
ORDINANCE III OF
2003
BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISISON
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINACNE, 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 4th November, 2003]
No. Legis: 1-21/Law/73-II,
dated 4-11-2003.--The following Ordinance made, by the Governor of
Balochistan on 17th October, 2003, is hereby published for general
information:--
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Act II of 1989.---In the Balochistan Public Service Commission Act, 1989,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 3:--
(a) In
subsection (3), for the word "Government" the word
"Governor" shall be substituted.
(b) After
subsection (3), the following proviso shall be added:--
"Provided that no person
below the age of 55 years shall be appointed as Chairman or a Member of the
Commission. "

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Public Service Commission Amentment Ordinance 2003
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of Act II of 1989

ORDINANCE III OF 2003
ORDINANCE III OF
2003
BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISISON
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINACNE, 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Public Service Commission Act, 1989
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 4th November, 2003]
No. Legis: 1-21/Law/73-II,
dated 4-11-2003.--The following Ordinance made, by the Governor of
Balochistan on 17th October, 2003, is hereby published for general
information:--
3. Amendment of section 4 of
Act II of 1989.----In the said Act, for section 4, the following shall be
substituted:--
"4. Terms of office of
Chairman and Member.---(1) The term of office of the Chairman or a
Member of the Commission shall be five years:
Provided that a Member, who
immediately before his appointment as Member was holding a post in the service
of Pakistan may be transferred in public interest before the expiry of his term
of office.
(2) The Chairman or a member may
resign his office by writing under his hand addressed to the Governor. "
